##### Project general facts

Sunridge is a contemporary waterfront residential development offering a refined coastal lifestyle with stunning views of the marina and the Arabian Gulf. The project features a premium collection of 1 and 2-bedroom apartments designed for modern living, where elegant architecture meets a relaxed seaside atmosphere. With its prime location close to the promenade and canal pool, Sunridge delivers a resort-style experience within a vibrant urban setting.

Residents benefit from a well-balanced lifestyle surrounded by leisure and entertainment options, including waterfront walkways, beach access, and nearby dining and retail destinations. The development is designed to encourage outdoor living and relaxation, with easy access to some of the area’s most attractive destinations, creating a seamless blend of comfort and coastal vibrancy.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials and a carefully considered neutral palette that enhances natural light and space. Open-plan layouts are complemented by floor-to-ceiling windows that frame panoramic views and extend the living experience outdoors. The kitchens are equipped with appliances, while the apartments are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Rashid Yachts & Marina is the new global destination for discerning yacht owners to experience Dubai’s buzzing scene in an elegant environment where beauty and luxury collide. Designed to encapsulate the ultimate modern waterfront architecture, it combines luxury residences and a full-service marina with an appealing mix of restaurants and shops, creating a unique definition of “living at sea”.

The new marina at Rashid Yachts & Marina offers convenient, hassle-free access to Dubai, accommodating 430 wet berths for yachts up to 100m long with a range of flexible berthing options, from a single night through to seasonal and annual stays.

When it comes to retail therapy, nobody does it better than Dubai. The nearby Downtown Dubai is the city’s most famous shopping district, and it’s packed with chic boutiques that will satisfy your every fancy. Rashid Yachts & Marina’s promenade has floating restaurants, cafés, lounges, and beach bars, while downtown Dubai is home to the city’s top dining and nightlife options and is conveniently located just a short distance away.
